name: Made by hand
source: library: the process / craft close-up format, described generically
essence: Slow, tactile close-ups of the material and the making, each held long enough to feel, building to the finished piece. Craft shown, not claimed.
why_it_works: Texture close-ups are satisfying and stop the thumb
It proves quality instead of saying it
Calm pacing stands out in a fast feed

hook.pattern: a quiet statement of where or how it's made, e.g. 'made by hand in {place}'
hook.first_frame: an extreme close-up of weave, stitch or grain

beats.text: {a true detail about material or making}

sound: soft ambient or acoustic; let the texture breathe
needs: a true fact about how or where it's made
keep: the finished piece as the payoff
drop: any maker's hands or face that aren't the business's own
